label: Notion: On New Database Item
description: Fires once per row added to a Notion database. Activation starts from now (history never replays) and the position survives restarts.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Notion access (wire a NotionAccess node).

inputs.name: database
inputs.label: Database
inputs.placeholder: Paste the database's link or id

inputs.name: source
inputs.label: Source
inputs.placeholder: Only needed when the database has several sources

inputs.name: intervalSecs
inputs.label: Check every (seconds)
inputs.description: How often the database is checked for new rows.

outputs.name: page
outputs.description: The new row, the raw Notion page object.
